title: To do($x$) or not to do($x$): Medical Image Counterfactuals for Dataset Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.14124v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical image analysis is often hindered by biased datasets, which can lead to biased models and limited clinical applicability. A promising strategy for mitigating such biases is to augment training data with synthetic images. Counterfactual (CF) generation is one such strategy, though the term is used in two different senses: in some works, CFs are produced through causality-based interventions derived from structural causal models, whereas in others, they are produced by non-causal image edits or conventional conditional generative models, such as altering anatomy or adding pathologies. In this work, we study this distinction and evaluate its practical consequences for medical image augmentation. translated_title: 做(x)还是不做：用于数据集增强的医学图像反事实
translated_abstract: 医学图像分析常常受到有偏数据集的阻碍，这可能导致有偏的模型和有限的临床适用性。缓解此类偏差的一种有前景的策略是使用合成图像来增强训练数据。反事实生成就是这样一种策略，但该术语在两种不同的意义上被使用：在一些工作中，反事实是通过基于结构因果模型导出的因果干预来产生的；而在另一些工作中，反事实则是通过非因果的图像编辑或常规的条件生成模型产生的，例如改变解剖结构或添加病理。在这项工作中，我们研究了这种区别，并评估了其对医学图像增强的实际影响。我们比较了三种条件化策略：确定性策略，即在保持其余变量固定的情况下改变选定的变量；无向策略，即根据学习到的统计关联来更新变量；
tldr: 该论文区分了医学图像反事实生成中基于因果干预的方法与基于统计关联的非因果方法，并评估了这三种条件化策略在数据集增强中的实际效果差异。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates the distinction between causality-based interventions and non-causal statistical approaches in medical image counterfactual generation, evaluating the practical consequences of three conditioning strategies for dataset augmentation.
